function.name: FlightSearch
function.description: Search for flights between two cities on a specific date. Returns available flights with price, departure time, arrival time, and duration.

function.name: RestaurantSearch

city.description: City name to search restaurants in (e.g., 'Rockford', 'Pensacola')

function.name: AccommodationSearch

city.description: City name to search accommodations in (e.g., 'Rockford', 'Pensacola')

function.name: AttractionSearch

city.description: City name to search attractions in (e.g., 'Rockford', 'Pensacola')

function.name: DistanceMatrix

mode.description: Travel mode: 'driving' for self-driving, 'taxi' for taxi

function.name: CitySearch
function.description: Search for cities in a specific US state. Returns a list of city names in that state.

function.name: FlightSearch
function.description: Search for flights between two cities on a specific date. Returns available flights with price, departure time, arrival time, and duration.

function.name: RestaurantSearch
function.description: Search for restaurants in a specific city. Returns restaurant names, cuisines, average cost, and ratings.

city.description: City name to search restaurants in (e.g., 'Rockford', 'Pensacola')

function.name: AccommodationSearch
function.description: Search for accommodations (hotels, apartments) in a specific city. Returns accommodation names, room types, prices, and house rules.

city.description: City name to search accommodations in (e.g., 'Rockford', 'Pensacola')

function.name: AttractionSearch
function.description: Search for tourist attractions in a specific city. Returns attraction names, addresses, and contact information.

city.description: City name to search attractions in (e.g., 'Rockford', 'Pensacola')

function.name: DistanceMatrix
function.description: Get driving distance and duration between two cities. Useful for planning self-driving trips.

mode.description: Travel mode: 'driving' for self-driving, 'taxi' for taxi

function.name: CitySearch
function.description: Search for cities in a specific US state. Returns a list of city names in that state.
